protocol.name: pvt_zoom_v1
protocol.purpose: Evaluation-only. The locked two-pass zoom (SCZ, configuration t15) is applied, unchanged, to the three Polyp-PVT models of polyp_pvt_kvasir_v1. Question: is the scale dependence that SCZ addresses specific to the frozen 224 x 224 vision-language model, or does SCZ also help a dedicated network that was trained end to end at 352 x 352 with multi-scale training? Nothing is trained; the outcome is reported whatever it is and changes neither the method nor the Polyp-PVT reference results.
protocol.locked_before: This protocol and its code were written after the single-pass results of seed 666 of polyp_pvt_kvasir_v1 had been inspected (a preview at the request of the first author) and before any two-pass result of any Polyp-PVT model existed.

procedure.first_pass: the accepted Polyp-PVT inference (352 x 352 input, sum of both outputs, sigmoid)
procedure.localisation: area fraction and bounding box of the first prediction at threshold 0.5 on the 352 x 352 output grid
procedure.window: the accepted rule of research_zoom.geometry with the constants below; never zooms out
procedure.second_pass: the window is cut from the original pixels, resized to 352 x 352 and segmented by the same model
procedure.fusion: second-pass map replaces the first inside the window; zero outside; first pass kept if the second is empty

zoom.fusion: second-pass map replaces the first inside the window; zero outside; first pass kept if the second is empty

reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.statistic: two-pass minus single-pass DSC, percentage points; mean over the three seeds of paired image-level differences; macro mean over the four OOD sets with a bootstrap interval and a sign-flip permutation test; the same for ETIS-Larib
reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.scz_transfers: the macro OOD gain is positive, its interval excludes zero and it is positive for each seed
reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.scz_harms: the macro OOD gain is negative and its interval excludes zero
reading_rules_fixed_in_advance.consequence: scz_transfers: SCZ is reported as a test-time procedure that also helps a dedicated network. no_effect or scz_harms: the manuscript states that the scale dependence addressed by SCZ is specific to the frozen 224 x 224 model and that a network with multi-scale training does not benefit.

disclosures: The five polyp test sets were used in earlier stages of this project.
ETIS-Larib is evaluated here once for the combination of Polyp-PVT with SCZ; the evaluation of our own method on it stays closed.
CVC-300 and CVC-ColonDB share 52 exact image hashes.
No constant of SCZ is adapted to Polyp-PVT; in particular the target fraction is not tuned.
